s01FF5B.name: Iggy/Larry: draw splash at sink point
summary: $01FF5B: draws one 16x16 OAM tile (OAM slot $70) at ([$14B8] - 8, [$14BA] + $60), the spot where the boss sprite last was when it sank
(probably a lava splash). Tile cycles through $2C/$2E every 2 frames, X-flip on frames where DATA_01FF57 = $40, palette bits from
DATA_01FEB7 indexed by sprite state. Called from the boss death sequence at $01FC5E.
$01FF98: computes the sprite's centre-ish point into [$14B4]/[$14B6] (X + 8, Y + $0F, 16-bit) and calls CODE_01CC9D, which
appears to be a Map16 tile lookup for that point (carry result used by the Iggy ball code at $01FA9A).

s01FFBF.name: Freespace: $FF padding to end of bank

lines.01FF90: } Y = OAM slot offset / 4: index into the size table
lines.01FF91: A = 2: 16x16 sprite size, X-high bit clear
lines.01FFB9: Check the point against level tiles (CODE_01CC9D, probably Map16 lookup)
